fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on Miami Beach governance and the mayoral race (including Abraham Frank Katzentine and John Levi), criticism of proposed liquor/beer taxation and licensing in Dade County, and discussion of crime and policing (including a satirical 'Coppers’ Courtesy Code'). Also contains letters to the editor about working conditions and wages at the Biltmore Hotel, local society/column items, advertisements, radio schedules, and horse-racing tips and coverage (Pimlico/Bowie).
